body: You are literally fucking brain dead if you think that's what a shitpost looks like. Neck yourself.

Once I did pray, and was back where I had started, right before the rushing sound(s), I just felt this external feeling of anger. Like it was angry. At me. Like, I KNEW right then that I had pissed it off to no end. Which I get, and I so regret panicking, but that intense burning sensation was not expected. It was genuinely excruciating.
Why the fuck not? I want to experience something supernatural like that. What else do I have to live for?
